title: Supply, Installation & Commissioning of Produced Water Treatment Package
location: Bu Hasnah Field — Central Processing Facility (CPF-2) — Abu Dhabi, UAE

mandatory_docs_detail.D1: Company profile incl. valid UAE/home-country trade licence — PDF, max 20 pages
mandatory_docs_detail.D2: Technical proposal with equipment list and datasheets — PDF
mandatory_docs_detail.D3: Itemized commercial proposal, priced in AED, with bill of quantities — PDF/Excel
mandatory_docs_detail.D4: HSE management plan incl. risk register, emergency response, waste management — PDF
mandatory_docs_detail.D5: Valid ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certificates — PDF
mandatory_docs_detail.D6: Valid ICV certificate issued by ADNOC-approved ICV certifier — PDF
mandatory_docs_detail.D7: Company organisation chart and CVs of key personnel — PDF
mandatory_docs_detail.D8: Bid bond of 2% of total bid value, valid 150 days from bid deadline — original or bank-guaranteed copy
mandatory_docs_detail.D9: Signed letter of undertaking accepting RFP terms and conditions (Appendix A) — PDF

currency_rule: All prices in AED, fixed and firm. USD at AED 3.6725 if converted.
payment_milestones: 10% on LOA, 60% supply milestones, 20% mechanical completion, 10% provisional acceptance
performance_test: 72-hour continuous run at ≥ 95% design flow, OiW by IP 426 / OSPAR GC-FID
